t: 德川幕府被废除；萨摩藩和长州的代理人夺取了权力。
te: The Tokugawa shogunate is abolished; agents of Satsuma and Chōshū seize power.
dz: 日本明治维新：德川幕府被废除；萨摩藩和长州的代理人夺取了权力。
de: Meiji Restoration in Japan: The Tokugawa shogunate is abolished; agents of Satsuma and Chōshū seize power.

t: 鸟羽伏见之战在德川幕府和亲帝国派系之间爆发；这将以幕府的失败而告终，是明治维新的关键点。

dz: 戊辰战争：鸟羽伏见之战在德川幕府和亲帝国派系之间爆发；这将以幕府的失败而告终，是明治维新的关键点。
de: Boshin War: The Battle of Toba–Fushimi begins, between forces of the Tokugawa shogunate and pro-Imperial factions; it will end in defeat for the shogunate, and is a pivotal point in the Meiji Restoration.

t: 亲帝国势力从德川会战中夺取了大阪城堡并焚毁于地.

de: Pro-Imperial forces capture Osaka Castle from the Tokugawa shogunate and burn it to the ground.
